name: earcon
description: Plays a short sound when Claude Code needs your attention and when it finishes a turn. Bring your own sound from a file, a URL, or YouTube.

on_attention.title: Sound when Claude needs you
on_attention.description: Permission prompts, multi-option questions, and plan approvals.

on_done.title: Sound when Claude finishes
on_done.description: Plays once per turn, when control comes back to you.

attention_sound.title: Attention sound
attention_sound.description: Optional. Leave empty for the bundled tone, or set one later with `earcon set attention <file|url>`.

done_sound.title: Done sound
done_sound.description: Optional. Leave empty for the bundled tone, or set one later with `earcon set done <file|url>`.
